    AI Overview
    Poppy Kennedy McIlroy, born August 31, 2020, is the only child of Rory McIlroy and his wife, Erica Stoll. She often appears with her father at golf events, including the Masters Par 3 Contest. McIlroy has described his daughter as a positive influence who puts his life and career into perspective. 
    • Birth: Poppy was born on August 31, 2020, at 12:15 p.m. in Jupiter, Florida.
    • Name Origin: Rory and Erica chose the name Poppy after considering other flower-based names like Rose and Iris.
    • Family Moments: Following his 2026 Masters win, a jubilant scene showed McIlroy celebrating with his wife and daughter at Augusta.
    • Golf Life: She has appeared at the Masters Par 3 contest multiple times since 2023.
    • Personality: McIlroy has described her as "unbelievably polite, respectful, and well-behaved". 
    Poppy's presence has shifted her father's focus, helping him manage the highs and lows of his professional golf career.
